title: Bust Tauri Home summary asset cache
summary: Made Tauri load the corrected Home CSV rerun status code and taught Home to use worker-progress evidence when CSV staging/import is active.
reason: The Tauri shell could show CSV rerun details in the Live Run worker tile while the Home top cards and Next 5 Videos stayed in normal queue mode because the shell could keep old JS assets and the CSV override only read stdout-tail evidence.
behavior_before: Tauri could keep stale unversioned Home/progress scripts, and Home only switched to CSV rerun summary mode when stdout-tail evidence looked active.
behavior_after: Tauri receives versioned Home/progress assets, and Home switches the top cards and Next 5 Videos into CSV staging/import mode when worker-progress rows report active CSV copy/staging evidence. Once the rerun moves into normal encode/remux processing, Home shows the normal processing progress.
manual_validation: Live API on http://127.0.0.1:8765/ served versioned progressView, app/topbar, app/home, and app.js URLs with the worker-aware parser present.
Tauri shell was reloaded and captured showing the rerun had moved into normal Encoding progress on Home.
rollback_plan: Remove the asset version query strings and revert the worker-aware CSV activity parser/Home call-site changes plus the related tests.
notes:
Version Home/progress assets so Tauri reloads corrected CSV summary code.
Add worker-aware CSV rerun activity evidence used by Home.
Pass full live-run context to CSV Home summary cards.
Use combined CSV activity evidence for Next 5 Videos override.
Cover worker-active CSV staging evidence for Home Next 5 and static guards.
Cover cache-busted Tauri WebView asset URLs.
Guard shared CSV rerun progress parser on read-only Home surfaces.
